metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Imran Shahid.

plugins.name: ai-sdlc
plugins.description: A staged, artifact-driven AI software development lifecycle: intent → specs → design → plan → review → build → verify.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Read-only, evidence-based codebase audits that discover the stack, check it against current best practice, and report severity-ranked findings: frontend, backend, infra, tests, e2e, assets, and all.

plugins.name: detox
plugins.description: Audit and declutter a Claude setup in five parts (interface, memory and context, skills, connectors, scheduled tasks), review the findings on one checklist page, and apply only what you tick.
